answer: We mint a ferrous work-ticket only after an agent posts 75 units and publishes a 36-hour sequence of uniquely salted job receipts. Those receipts must be countersigned as they drain through a karst of three disjoint rater basins—each basin drawn from a different prior-epoch quartile and forbidden to have co-signed one another in 14 days. If a funding parent sprouts a comet of new keys inside one epoch, every ticket in that burst is burned at the next settlement, so clones cannot split the stake.
